title: AlgedonicBreachFeedbackSignal
description: FeedbackSignal kind emitted when a bounding Commitment's limit has been breached (stock has crossed the bound). Emission is hysteresis-bounded (no re-fire while the breach remains open) and at most one open signal exists per (declarer, target, kind). Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim zome's existing FeedbackSignal entry type via signal_kind vocabulary; no new DHT entry type). standing_impact is fixed 'advisory' — the signal informs, it does not itself withdraw standing.
$comment: Source of truth: DHT (FeedbackSignal entry); this file is the wire contract only.

target.description: CID of the promise (Commitment) threatened by the breach.

declarer.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent (typically storage validator or operator's elohim-counsel) that declared the breach.

stock.description: The measured stock level at time of breach.

bound_ref.description: CID of the bounding commitment/manifest whose limit was breached.
